thread:
lara: Heads-up — found 3 stale snippets in /optimize/guide and a 404 on the quant-profiles link (around line ~420). CI red on docs PR #4127. Can someone take point? @miguel?

miguel: I'll take a look. Which snippets — python, go, js?

lara: python and go examples for batching + kv-prefetch, plus one TS embed sample. The quant profile link redirects to a deprecated page and the snippet args don't match the new SDK.

miguel: OK. Quick plan: (1) fix link to /optimize/quant-profiles/v2 (2) update python snippet to new SDK call shape (`OptKit`) (3) add a tiny CI smoke test that renders sample code blocks. I'll open a PR.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4189 — miguel added. CI: pending.

tara: I can help review the Go snippet. Tag me when ready.

miguel: Pushed a draft in the PR, moved python snippet from `client.generate()` to `optkit.generate_batch()` and added an inline example. Snippet: ```python
from redwood import OptKit
opt = OptKit()
resp = opt.generate_batch(["hi"], batching=True)
print(resp[0].text)
``` Need to validate argument names and defaults.

zach: Small nit: prefer `batching_policy='latency-optimised'` in examples to show tradeoffs. Also add a short note on int4 quant caveats for quality-sensitive workloads.

tara: Go snippet looks good overall, but add the import path and `defer opt.Close()` in the example to show cleanup. Also prefer explicit `ctx` usage.

miguel: Made those edits — switched example to `batching_policy='latency-optimised'`, added Go import & defer, and fixed the quant profiles link. Added a docs CI smoke renderer that searches for `optkit` codeblocks and ensures they compile (basic lint). CI passed on my fork; awaiting main repo checks.

docs-bot: CI status: docs build failed on staging due to a broken anchor in guides/anchors.md line 78. @lara can you patch?

lara: On it — pushing a tiny commit to fix the anchor and a clarifying sentence about when to prefer prefix caching vs full KV prefetch. Should be final.

tara: :thumbsup: I'll do the review once CI is green.

docs-bot: PR merged by miguel — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4189 — release note: "optkit docs: update batching/caching snippets, quant-profile link fix"

lara: Thanks everyone — leaving a short follow-up checklist in the PR for backport to v1-site and for an example test we can run on dedicated capacity workloads.
